description: This class includes the manufacture of refractory ceramic goods.
includes: manufacture of refractory mortars, concretes and similar compositions
manufacture of refractory ceramic goods: retorts, crucibles, muffles, nozzles, plugs, supports, cupels, tubes, pipes, sheaths and rods
manufacture of refractory bricks, blocks, tiles and similar refractory ceramic constructional goods
manufacture of refractory goods containing magnesite, dolomite or chromite
